facts.fact: The National Assembly Library Trust Fund summary calls the National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy (2020-2030) Nigeria's flagship digital transformation roadmap, built around eight pillars from regulation and infrastructure to digital literacy and local content; the stated period runs to 2030, and the source does not say whether the text is public, so the value rests on the period alone; the source's published date is used.
